About this program
Create a common language for scientific collaboration.
In this program, you'll engage in rigorous study while contributing to emerging cross-sector opportunities and driving transdisciplinary research. Working collaboratively with researchers from a multitude of fields, you'll share a common language and engage in research outside your areas of expertise. Our team-taught courses will give you a deeper understanding of the intrinsic link between applied physics and materials science that has made them foundational disciplines for next-generation technologies in nano-, meso- and quantum science.Available Emphases\n\nApplied Physics\nMaterials Science
